messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI flagged the audit-event-validator on staging. Regression on KMS rotation events, failing golden fixture sampling. See pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4842 

audit-bot: Build #4842 failed (tests: audit-validator). Triage required.

lia: Can you paste the failing assertion or a short stack? schema drift vs golden data mismatch?

maya: Failure is in validate_event.py:72 — AssertionError: missing field kms_key_id. Golden sample includes legacy structure. Excerpt:
```
{\n  "event_type": "kms.rotation",\n  "kms_key": { "id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abc123", "region": "us-west-2" },\n  "actor": "service-account"\n}
```

tom: That looks like older payloads where we nested kms_key object. New schema expects kms_key_id string. My hunch: sampler pulled archived rows that never got migrated.

samir: I uploaded the exact sample: s3://redwood-audits/ci-fail-samples/2165432100.json — contains the nested kms_key object as shown above.

lia: Two approaches: (A) make validator accept both shapes for now, and add normalization layer in ingestion; (B) tighten validator and update generator to include legacy sample so CI doesn't regress. We should probably do A + generator change.

maya: Agree. Also we need per-customer strictness. Some enterprise/private customers want strict schema enforcement. Proposal: validator config flag `allow_legacy_kms_key: true|false` and CI repo default stays true until we're ready to flip. When set false, CI should fail fast and we send advisory.

tom: I'll sketch the schema change. Suggestion (JSON Schema fragment):
```
"kms_key_id": {\n  "oneOf": [ { "type": "string" }, { "type": "null" } ]\n},\n"kms_key": {\n  "type": ["object", "null"],\n  "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" } },\n  "additionalProperties": false\n}\n```
Normalization rule in ingestion: prefer kms_key_id, else use kms_key.id.

lia: Also update golden fixtures generator to include one legacy-format sample per event-type in the CI set so we don't get blind regressions. Add unit test in sampler to filter archived vs live if config requires it.

maya: Action items: tom — PR for validator changes + config flag + docs; lia — update golden fixtures generator and sampler tests; samir — rerun CI with extra samples and verify. I will draft a short customer advisory template in case we flip the flag for private deploys.

samir: On it. I'll queue a CI rerun after I attach new samples to the artifact. audit-bot: Rerun queued by @samir: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4857

tom: I'll open the PR now and tag @lia @maya. ETA EOD for initial patch.

lia: Quick thought — we should add a schema_version bump (v3) and migration notes in CHANGELOG so ops can plan.

maya: Good call. Add migration snippet in the PR description and link to the ingestion normalizer code.

samir: If we accept both shapes in validator, let's add a small fuzz test to catch weird types (e.g., kms_key.id as number).

tom: Will add that.

lia: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team — keeping this on the radar. I'll follow up with the advisory once we decide default config for hosted vs private.

audit-bot: Reminder: please add `changelog/` entry when merging — policy requirement.
